Layer it over a fine-knit turtleneck with straight-fit trousers or dark denim and clean sneakers, or wear it open over a hoodie for a sophisticated look.

● Gentle handling; do not rub

● Do not bleach
● Do not iron

9339301003515.title: Ombre
